statusVocabulary.IMPLEMENTED: YES | PARTIAL | NO - code for the capability exists on the integration head (PARTIAL = open implementation blockers).
statusVocabulary.TESTED: YES | PARTIAL | NOT_ASSESSED - automated tests at the integration head exercise it (fixtures, real-PG, or both; see evidence). NOT_ASSESSED = not mapped in this pass, NOT a pass.
statusVocabulary.DEPLOYED: per environment: YES (code at the deployed SHA) | NO | UNVERIFIED. Alpha = 5513275 (CTO Railway authority); Production = BE 5b714833 / FE 58f80fd4.
statusVocabulary.ENABLED: per environment: YES | OFF_BY_DEFAULT (flag absent by default; Railway value not re-measured) | UNVERIFIED | N/A.
statusVocabulary.LIVE_VERIFIED: per environment: YES (independently exercised live, with evidence) | NEGATIVE (live evidence shows the capability is NOT working there) | NOT_RUN. A report, fixture, preview route or provider name never sets YES. CTO deployment authority proves DEPLOYED, not LIVE_VERIFIED.
statusVocabulary.BLOCKED: open blocker IDs from 10-PRODUCTION-BLOCKERS (plus EA-* additions).
statusVocabulary.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: named parts of the capability with no code at the integration head.

derivationRules: Alpha DEPLOYED/ENABLED derive from 02 alphaState: ALPHA_LIVE -> YES/YES; ASK_BOUND, RETAINED_ONLY, COVERAGE_GAP, PREVIEW_ONLY -> YES/UNVERIFIED; LOCAL_ONLY -> YES/OFF_BY_DEFAULT; DESIGN_ONLY, ABSENT -> NO/N/A.
Production DEPLOYED/ENABLED derive from 02 productionState: UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME -> YES/UNVERIFIED; COVERAGE_GAP -> YES/UNVERIFIED; ABSENT -> NO/N/A.

IMPLEMENTED derives from alphaState (ABSENT/DESIGN_ONLY -> NO), open blockers or named NOT_IMPLEMENTED parts (any -> PARTIAL, none -> YES), then per-capability overrides below for work on the integration head.
LIVE_VERIFIED is NOT_RUN everywhere unless an override cites live evidence.
Overrides always win and must cite evidence.
